title: See how one block changes between prefill and decode
description: Choose an execution phase and checkpoint attention shape. The block stays logically equivalent, while score shape, KV traffic, and the pressure on each stage change.

phases.label: Prompt prefill
phases.detail: Process prompt positions together and create reusable KV state for every layer.
phases.result: The first generated token waits for the entire admitted prompt to traverse the stack.

phases.label: Autoregressive decode
phases.detail: Process one new position per active sequence while reusing all retained KV state.
phases.cacheAction: Read prior KV, append one position
phases.result: Each iteration emits at most one next token per active sequence, so cadence matters.

attentionVariants.label: Multi-head attention
attentionVariants.detail: One key head and one value head for each query head.
attentionVariants.effect: Largest KV state in this comparison; preserves independent KV projections for every query head.

attentionVariants.label: Grouped-query attention
attentionVariants.detail: Groups of four query heads share one key and value head.
attentionVariants.effect: One quarter of the MHA KV bytes for this reference shape, with checkpoint-compatible grouped projections.

attentionVariants.label: Multi-query attention
attentionVariants.detail: All query heads share one key head and one value head.
attentionVariants.effect: Smallest KV state in this comparison; quality and kernel support remain release-gate concerns.

stages.label: Input normalization
stages.prefillState: Apply over every admitted prompt position.
stages.decodeState: Apply to the newest position for each active sequence.

stages.label: Q, K, V projections
stages.prefillState: Project all prompt positions and prepare cache writes.
stages.decodeState: Project one new position; KV-head count controls appended state.

stages.label: Causal attention
stages.prefillState: Evaluate permitted prompt-token pairs without materializing future visibility.
stages.decodeState: Read retained keys and values for all visible prior positions.

stages.label: Attention residual
stages.prefillState: Merge the attention update for every prompt position.
stages.decodeState: Merge the update for each newly decoded position.

stages.label: Feed-forward network
stages.prefillState: Run the expanded hidden transform across prompt positions.
stages.decodeState: Run the transform for the current position in every active sequence.

stages.label: Output residual
stages.prefillState: Pass all prompt representations to the next layer.
stages.decodeState: Pass current-position representations to the next layer.
